note: Every place Nina's Map reads from. kind: 'dataset' is machine-readable and refreshed by a script; 'roster' is an official page that lists many entries, read by hand or by a browser; 'per-listing' is checked one organization at a time. evidence: 'official' = a government or a Nation publishing about itself; 'first-party' = the organization's own site; 'lead' = a directory or news item used only to find candidates, never published as the source. cadence_days: how often to re-read. Blocked or failed reads go in pipeline/queue.json, never as a fresh check date.
